reuse.why: Changes only the existing private worst-case helpers behind getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is simplified to Math.min and amount minus threshold in the single existing definition.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where every consumer (budget templates, forecast, balances, UI) obtains it via getScheduledAmount.

scope.why: Touches only the two helpers, their comment, the matching tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Smaller, clearer code with a comment stating the new lowest-value rule and tests covering order and zero-spanning ranges.
